text:
emma: Heads-up: Solstice Retail wants a short POC. Requirements: streaming resume across reconnects, function-calls to their webhook backend, and bounded batching (tail <150ms). Security checklist + pricing are blockers. Can eng + SDK confirm approach?

raj: confirm we support reconnect headers in SDKs. pattern = session-id + resume-index + call-id for tool calls. default resume TTL for hosted POC = 30s. Dedicated can extend with local redis.

flo: for webhooks recommend idempotency via X-Redwood-Call-Id. if they can't change webhook, we can enable dedupe log in Dedicated POC.

ben: pricing: POC estimate = 2 weeks, ~400k tokens, expect ~4% resumes. recommend offering a trial credit covering up to 1.05x tokens to cover replays. hosted billing still per-token; resumed tokens only billed if model re-generation occurs.

sec-bot: security Q received: do resume blobs contain user prompts? retention? KMS used?

raj: short answer: blobs store KV-deltas + indices + checksum, not plaintext prompts. encrypted with envelope keys in our KMS (hosted). TTL enforced (30s default). Dedicated/private supports customer-managed KMS. audit logs capture resume access.

flo: sample reconnect headers to show customer:
```
Authorization: Bearer <token>
X-Redwood-Session: solstice-42
X-Redwood-Resume-Index: 120
X-Redwood-Call-Id: call_2026_01
```

emma: note on tool-calls: runtime does NOT replay side-effects by default. require idempotent webhooks or enable "call-log" in Dedicated to allow safe replay. include this in runbook.

ben: infra note: staging canary shows resume success 96% under 80 concurrent streams, median resume latency 14ms. Dedicated appetite: increase TTL and persist resume-state to local redis for bursts.

emma: action items: 1) raj/flo: produce 1-pager + node/go snippets for resume + call-id pattern 2) ben: write pricing credit proposal 3) security: provide short answers for questionnaire. I'll send to customer after docs.

flo: will draft 1-pager and SDK snippets today, include idempotency guidance. :thumbsup:
